cards.front: Squat — name the primary muscles working
cards.back: Quads, glutes, hamstrings — core and spinal erectors stabilize

cards.front: Squat depth: where should your hips get to?
cards.back: Hip crease at or below the top of the knee — 'parallel' or lower

cards.front: Where should your knees track during a squat?
cards.back: In line with your toes — pushed out, never caving inward

cards.front: When do you brace your core in a squat?
cards.back: Big breath and brace at the top, before you descend — hold it through the rep

cards.front: Where does the weight sit on your feet?
cards.back: Mid-foot — heels and big toe stay planted the whole rep
